name: Kandura
notes: Emirati and Omani name of the thobe; Riwaya FAQ names kandura for the UAE and Oman

name: Dishdasha
notes: Kuwaiti and Omani thobe; Omani collarless with chest tassel, Kuwaiti stiff collar; Riwaya sells Omani Mint Dishdasha

name: Jalabiya (galabeya)
notes: Loose wide-sleeved men's robe; Jumia Egypt Men Galabeya category, 59 products

name: Djellaba
notes: Hooded long robe of the Maghreb; FENNA has a Gandoras & Djellabas category

name: Gandoura
notes: Loose short-sleeved or sleeveless robe of the Maghreb; FENNA Gandoras & Djellabas category

name: Agbada
notes: Men's wide robe sold as a set with tunic (buba) and trousers (sokoto); Mumini Fashion Empire sells men's agbadas

name: Kurta pyjama
notes: Knee-length kurta with matching pyjama; Manyavar White Kurta Pajama category; replaces the kurta-set named form of HVMK

name: Ao dai
notes: Long tunic split to the waist worn over trousers; two-piece set sold on Weee

name: Baju kurung
notes: Loose knee-length tunic worn over a long skirt; POPLOOK, Jakel, AEON Puteri Baju Kurung Set

name: Baju Melayu
notes: Men's tunic and trouser set, worn with a sampin; Jakel sells baju kurung and baju Melayu

name: Puletasi
notes: Two-piece long tunic and skirt; Samoa Island Designs usually sells puletasi and shirts

name: Qipao (cheongsam)
notes: Fitted one-piece dress with a mandarin collar and side slits; Dreamscaped qipaos in short and three-quarter sleeves

name: Deel
notes: Side-fastened belted robe; MD Mongolia deel category

name: Gho
notes: Men's robe hitched to the knee and belted; sold in Thimphu (Sephub Gyeltsen Tsongkhang); Wangpe Couture collection centred on gho and kira

name: Chapan
notes: Long open-front robe-coat with sash, often adras or ikat; Mursak Chapans for men and women

name: Kira
notes: Rectangular cloth wrapped round the body as an ankle-length dress, clasped at the shoulders; 1stdibs kira listings; Thimphu shops

name: Toub (lafaya)
notes: Length of cloth wrapped at the waist and draped over head and shoulder, worn over a dress; Sonjiki sells Toubs / Lafayas

name: Manteau (manto)
notes: Iranian women's long or short coat worn for modest dress; replaces NF-A1.4.2.06-R001 under overcoat

name: Keffiyeh (shemagh, ghutra)
notes: Checked square cloth worn on the head (with agal) or round the neck; Hirbawi, Hebron, since 1961; replaces NF-A1.6.03-083 and NF-A1.7.01-R001

name: Dashiki
notes: Loose pullover tunic shirt with embroidered V-neck; Mumini Fashion Empire sells dashikis

name: Barong tagalog
notes: Sheer embroidered formal tunic shirt worn untucked; Barongs R Us pina-jusi, jusi, organza barong categories

name: Vyshyvanka
notes: Embroidered linen or cotton tunic shirt; Rozetka lists over 10,000 men's vyshyvankas (UkrModa)

name: Huipil
notes: Loose woven or embroidered women's tunic; Huipil de mi corazón sells traditional and stylised huipiles

name: Aloha shirt
notes: Printed camp-collar button-up shirt; Kahala, Honolulu, first brand to manufacture aloha shirts

name: Guayabera
notes: Button-up shirt with pleats or embroidery, worn untucked; Nora Quintana Luna makes guayaberas in Granada

name: Kebaya
notes: Fitted front-opening blouse often embroidered, worn with a sarong or pareo; Moleq, Anya Kebaya, Ang Eng Nyonya Kebaya

name: Bisht
notes: Men's cloak worn over the thobe; Al Bisht Al Fakhir, Souq Waqif, Doha; Al Qiyafa (Libya) makes bisht

name: Pollera
notes: Full gathered skirt worn over petticoats by cholas; Diseños Esmeralda and Cecilia Paco make and sell polleras, La Paz

name: Kilt
notes: Men's pleated wrapped tartan skirt, 8-yard traditional; St Kilda Store (Glasgow), USA Kilts

name: Lederhosen
notes: Leather shorts or knee breeches, often with braces; trachten.de men's lederhosen category

name: Traje de charro
notes: Mariachi or charro suit of short jacket and fitted trousers with silver botonadura; Mariachi Depot trajes charros
